columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Durable agent memory needs migration evidence before model upgrades can inherit it
columns.title_zh: 持久 Agent 记忆在模型升级后继续继承前，需要独立的迁移证据
columns.source_zh: arXiv 2609.05339 一手受控研究：比较固定 Schema、自然语言 Notes 与 Embedding Index 在模型/Embedding 升级后的语义可移植性
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260908-003 after Skill 02 triage. The controlled study separates physical durability from semantic portability: fixed-schema knowledge-graph memory transfers almost unchanged across writer swaps, while natural-language notes and embedding indexes can change materially and asymmetrically after model or embedding upgrades; retained source history materially improves recoverability. The bounded Digital Employee governance question is therefore whether a model upgrade may inherit an existing memory store merely because the bytes persist, or whether memory must be re-admitted through migration evidence that tests retrieval semantics, source provenance and recovery behavior. This is a primary empirical finding with a concrete failure mode and migration mechanism. It is materially distinct from the September 2 working-memory object, which focused on stored versus delivered context and management cost during long-running work; today's object focuses on semantic compatibility across model/embedding transitions.
columns.reason_zh: 经 Skill 02 筛选后选自 SIG-20260908-003。该受控研究明确区分物理持久性与语义可移植性：固定 Schema 的 Knowledge-graph Memory 在 Writer 替换后几乎保持不变，而自然语言 Notes 与 Embedding Index 在模型或 Embedding 升级后可能发生明显且方向不对称的变化；保留 Source History 能显著提高可恢复性。因此，边界清晰的数字员工治理问题是：模型升级后，是否因为 Memory Bytes 仍然存在就可以直接继承旧记忆，还是必须通过迁移证据重新准入，核验 Retrieval Semantics、Source Provenance 与 Recovery Behavior。该对象具有明确 Failure Mode、Migration Mechanism 与一手实证结果，并与 9 月 2 日 Working-memory 研究实质不同：后者关注长期运行中 Stored/Delivered Context 与管理成本，今天关注 Model/Embedding Transition 造成的语义兼容性。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the memory representations, writer/model and embedding swap matrix, bidirectional migration results, retrieval and task metrics, source-history recovery evidence, mixed-index behavior, re-embedding procedure, failure asymmetry, and limits on generalizing the study to production digital-employee memory systems.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 Memory Representation、Writer/Model 与 Embedding Swap Matrix、双向迁移结果、Retrieval/Task Metric、Source-history Recovery Evidence、Mixed-index 行为、Re-embedding Procedure、Failure Asymmetry，以及将研究结论推广到生产数字员工记忆系统时的边界。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Agent replacement needs coordination-compatibility evidence, not role matching alone
columns.title_zh: Agent 替换需要 Coordination Compatibility 证据，而不能只看角色匹配
columns.source_zh: arXiv 2609.05279 一手受控团队替换研究：测量 Role-matched Agent Swap 后的任务表现与 Communication Cost
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260908-004 after Skill 02 triage. Controlled team-swap experiments report that a role-matched replacement can preserve much of task score while increasing communication cost per unit of progress by 16–63%; in Hanabi, a swapped agent can be costlier than an inexperienced agent because the original team accumulated coordination conventions. The bounded Industry Architecture question is what state and compatibility evidence must accompany agent replacement, failover or staffing changes when the team itself has learned conventions that are not represented by the role label. This is a primary research finding with an explicit counterexample to fungibility and a concrete handoff mechanism. It differs from the September 6 trust-mediated resilience object and September 7 institutional-enforcement object by focusing specifically on replacement compatibility and team-formation state rather than disruption phases or sanction authority.
columns.reason_zh: 经 Skill 02 筛选后选自 SIG-20260908-004。受控团队替换实验报告：Role-matched Replacement 往往能保留大部分任务得分，但单位进展的 Communication Cost 会增加 16–63%；在 Hanabi 中，Swap Agent 甚至可能比无经验 Agent 更昂贵，因为原团队已经形成协作惯例。因此，边界清晰的行业架构问题是：当团队本身已经学习了 Role Label 无法表达的 Coordination Convention 时，Agent Replacement、Failover 或 Staffing Change 必须携带哪些 Team State 与 Compatibility Evidence。该对象提供了对“角色相同即可互换”的直接反例和具体 Handoff Mechanism，并与 9 月 6 日 Trust-mediated Resilience、9 月 7 日 Institutional Enforcement 实质不同：今天聚焦 Replacement Compatibility 与 Team-formation State，而不是 Disruption Phase 或 Sanction Authority。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the team-formation and swap protocols, role-matching definition, task environments, 16–63% communication-cost calculation, task-score retention, Hanabi counterexample, formation-history effects, alternative baselines, compatibility metrics, and limits on transferring the findings to enterprise digital-employee teams.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 Team-formation/Swap Protocol、Role-matching 定义、Task Environment、16–63% Communication-cost 计算、Task-score Retention、Hanabi Counterexample、Formation-history Effect、Alternative Baseline、Compatibility Metric，以及将结论迁移到企业数字员工团队时的边界。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: GUI and CLI agent actions need one shared effect and provenance chain
columns.title_zh: GUI 与 CLI Agent 操作需要绑定到同一条 Effect 与 Provenance Chain
columns.source_zh: arXiv 2609.05374 CUA-Universe 一手基准研究：在可复现 Desktop VM 中让 GUI 与 CLI 共同作用于同一应用状态
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260908-005 after Skill 02 triage. CUA-Universe exposes GUI and command-line control over the same reproducible desktop applications, synthesizes hybrid tasks and verified trajectories, and reports substantial task-success and efficiency gains after training a 9B model in the environment. The bounded Open-source Engineering question is not which interface is better, but how execution identity, effect evidence and trajectory verification should remain unified when an agent switches control surfaces that mutate the same underlying application state. GUI-only or CLI-only evaluation can otherwise fragment one business effect into separate audit stories. This primary benchmark/research finding is materially distinct from the September 5 iterative-tool-use/scaling evaluation and September 7 independent-acceptance object: today's focus is cross-surface shared-state provenance and verification.
columns.reason_zh: 经 Skill 02 筛选后选自 SIG-20260908-005。CUA-Universe 在可复现 Desktop Application 上同时暴露 GUI 与 Command-line Control Surface，生成 Hybrid Task 与 Verified Trajectory，并报告在该环境训练 9B Model 后任务成功率和执行效率明显提升。边界清晰的开源工程问题不是“GUI 还是 CLI 更好”，而是：当 Agent 在两个都会修改同一底层 Application State 的 Control Surface 之间切换时，Execution Identity、Effect Evidence 与 Trajectory Verification 如何保持统一；否则 GUI-only 与 CLI-only 评估可能把同一个 Business Effect 拆成两套彼此断裂的审计叙事。该一手 Benchmark/Research Finding 与 9 月 5 日 Iterative Tool-use/Scaling Evaluation、9 月 7 日 Independent Acceptance 实质不同：今天聚焦 Cross-surface Shared-state Provenance 与 Verification。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the VM construction, application set, GUI/CLI surface mapping, hybrid-task synthesis, trajectory-verification method, training data, 9B-model setup, success/step/token metrics, external benchmark comparisons, cross-surface side-effect assumptions, and limits on treating benchmark trajectory verification as proof of production effect correctness.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 VM 构建、Application Set、GUI/CLI Surface Mapping、Hybrid-task Synthesis、Trajectory-verification Method、Training Data、9B Model 设置、Success/Step/Token Metric、External Benchmark Comparison、Cross-surface Side-effect Assumption，以及将 Benchmark Trajectory Verification 推广为生产 Effect Correctness 证明时的边界。
